tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. `text` reads on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the order ticket, list groups and input wells sitting on `bg`. All text tokens read on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, popovers and toasts. Pair with `shadow-sheet` or `shadow-popover`; in light the shadow does the separating.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Pressed states and the track behind segmented controls.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: an input's resting outline, checkbox frames. Holds 3:1 on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary copy, prices and numbers on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, supporting copy and inactive tabs on any surface.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps and units (USDC, BTC) on any surface. The floor: nothing dimmer carries text.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: primary buttons (Connect, Deposit, Review), the active nav item and selected chips. `on-brand` reads on it.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Links and brand-colored text on `bg`, `surface` and `brand-soft`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label on a `brand` fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, info banners and the selected market chip. `brand-text` reads on it.

tokens.name: long
tokens.usage: Long side fill: the Long button, up candles, the positive sparkline. Never on its own: pair with a word or ▲.

tokens.name: long-text
tokens.usage: Gains and the word Long on `bg`, `surface` and `long-soft`.

tokens.name: on-long
tokens.usage: Label on a `long` fill. Dark ink in the dark theme keeps 4.5:1 on the bright green.

tokens.name: long-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a Long badge or a filled-order toast.

tokens.name: short
tokens.usage: Short side fill: the Short button, down candles, the negative sparkline. Pair with a word or ▼.

tokens.name: short-text
tokens.usage: Losses, the word Short and destructive text on `bg`, `surface` and `short-soft`.

tokens.name: on-short
tokens.usage: Label on a `short` fill.

tokens.name: short-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a Short badge, an error banner or liquidation-risk callout.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and liquidation risk. Same hue as Short on purpose: a loss and a danger read alike; the copy says which.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Stale price, paused market, wrong network. Text and icon on `bg`, `surface` and `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning banners.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline with a 2px `bg` gap, so it holds 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs.

families.sans: "Geist Variable", Geist, "SF Pro Text", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: price-hero
styles.usage: The live price at the top of a market. One per screen. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: amount-input
styles.usage: The amount a person is typing in the order ticket or a funds sheet.

styles.name: balance
styles.usage: Account value on the Portfolio screen and in the account card.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Numbers in lists, positions and receipt rows. Tabular figures so columns align.

styles.name: num-sm
styles.usage: Secondary numbers: bid and ask, 24h volume, funding.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page titles on mobile (Markets, Portfolio) and dialog titles on desktop.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Market names in rows, button labels at large size, card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy. Explanations in sheets and empty states.
styles.sample: Your order fills at the quoted price or not at all.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Tabs, chips, medium buttons, field labels.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Help text under fields and rows; receipt labels.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Wallet addresses, transaction hashes and nonces only. Prices never use mono.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row inner padding on mobile; gap between preset chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; the side gutter at every width.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between ticket sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding of page titles on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, small buttons, the selected segment.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, medium and large buttons, market rows on hover.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the order ticket.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets; dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: status chips, the leverage pill, avatars and coin icons.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Wallet menu, market picker, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards in light only; dark separates with `surface` alone.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary action buttons (Long, Short, Confirm). Thumb-sized.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs. The minimum touch target.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Desktop-only compact buttons inside tables (Close). On touch, keep a 44px hit area.

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Desktop top bar height.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tab bar height, plus the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: size-ticket
tokens.usage: Desktop order ticket column width.

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Max content width on desktop.
